experiments.hypothesis: A tuned global score-distribution parameterization improves final-score NLL without degrading market proper scores.

experiments.success_rule: primary paired CI95 lower > 0 and every declared market non-regresses

experiments.hypothesis: Game-specific variance driven by total environment and uncertainty improves tail markets versus fixed global dispersion.
experiments.primary_metric: paired RL+Total Brier gain vs champion
experiments.success_rule: primary bootstrap CI95 lower > 0 with ML non-regression

experiments.hypothesis: A regularized learned remapping of champion run means removes systematic run-mean bias caused by heuristic weighting.
experiments.training_period: chronological first 70% of post-registration FINAL cohort after minimum sample
experiments.validation_period: chronological final 30% of same sealed cohort
experiments.success_rule: positive holdout MSE gain; nomination only until separate prospective probability validation

experiments.hypothesis: Strict-PIT contextual residual features add predictive information beyond champion run means.
experiments.success_rule: primary bootstrap CI95 lower > 0 and LogLoss non-regression
